# Environment setup + data cleaning

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

library(tidyr)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(ggiraph)

source("./utils.R")
```

Here, we're removing the duplicates from our analysis.

```{r}
flock_df <- read.csv("../data/flock_combined_24-26.csv") %>% 
  filter(duplicate_likely == FALSE) %>% 
  select(-dup1_check,
         -dup2_check,
         -duplicate_likely)

nrow(flock_df)
```

```{r}
flock_df$Search.Time <- as.Date.character(flock_df$Search.Time, format="%Y-%m-%d")
```

# Filtering by Violent Crimes

We have disaggregated the violent crimes into three different
categories, namely violent crimes, weapons offenses, and violent
descriptions. Below are the keywords that we used to find matches in the
'Reason' column of the Flock audit logs. Note that we are doing an exact
keyword match, which will exclude searches that are misspelled.

*Violent Crimes*:

- murder

- homicide

- manslaughter

- concealment of a body

- domestic

- agg (to capture aggravated, agg assault, etc)

- battery

- A&B (for assault and battery)

- ABDW (for assault and batter with a dangerous weapon)

- kidnap

- human trafficking

- arson

- rape

- robbery

- carjacking

*Weapons Offenses*:

- shots fired

- shooting

- weapon

- armed

- gun

- firearm

*Violent Description*: For these, note that

- violent

- violence

```{r}
VIOLENT_CRIMES <- "murder|homicide|manslaughter|concealment of a body|domestic|\\bagg|battery|kidnap|human trafficking|arson|\\ba&b\\b|\\babdw\\b|\\badw\\b|rape|robbery|carjacking"
WEAPONS_OFFENSES <- "shots fired|shooting|weapon|armed|gun|firearm"
VIOLENT_DESCR <- "violent|violence"

# add the appropriate columns
flock_df <- flock_df %>% 
  mutate(violent_crimes = grepl(VIOLENT_CRIMES, Reason, ignore.case = TRUE),
         weapons_crimes = grepl(WEAPONS_OFFENSES, Reason, ignore.case = TRUE),
         violent_desc = grepl(VIOLENT_DESCR, Reason, ignore.case = TRUE),
         all_violent = (violent_crimes | weapons_crimes | violent_desc))
```

```{r}
crime_stats <- flock_df %>% 
                  select(violent_crimes,
                         weapons_crimes,
                         violent_desc,
                         all_violent) %>% 
                  summarize(violent_perc = round(100 * mean(violent_crimes), digits=1),
                            weapons_perc = round(100 * mean(weapons_crimes), digits=1),
                            violence_desc_perc = round(100 * mean(violent_desc), digits=1),
                            all_percent = round(100 * mean(all_violent), digits=1))
```

```{r}
crime_stats <- flock_df %>% 
  filter(Search.Time >= as.Date("2025-01-01"),
         Search.Time <= as.Date("2025-12-31")) %>% 
  summarize(violent_perc = round(100 * mean(violent_crimes), digits=1),
            weapons_perc = round(100 * mean(weapons_crimes), digits=1),
            violence_desc_perc = round(100 * mean(violent_desc), digits=1),
            all_percent = round(100 * mean(all_violent), digits=1)) %>% 
  rbind(crime_stats) %>% 
  rename("Violent Crimes %" = violent_perc,
         "Weapons %" = weapons_perc,
         "Mention of Violence %" = violence_desc_perc,
         "Any mention %" = all_percent)

rownames(crime_stats) <- c("2025", "All Data")
```

```{r}
crime_stats
```
